Addressing concerns about the national debt, she said that since the post-COVID period, every nation has faced debt challenges. "We are committed to reducing the fiscal deficit, as evidenced by our annual budgets. We have openly stated our goal that by 2030, the national debt will be limited to 50 per cent of the GDP. Sitharaman told reporters here.
